changelog: - **A Monte Carlo result is marked "graph changed" on arrival when you edited the diagram during the run.** The run still finishes and shows the distribution of the diagram as it was when the run started; before, that result came in as current, with Export enabled, although the diagram no longer matched it. Now it arrives with the same tag and disabled Export that an edit after a run produces, and a new run at the current diagram clears the tag.
